answer: In this PoA design, each identity posts bonded collateral, while correlated equivocation among k coordinated identities is detected through shared evidence and penalized at O(k^2), preventing a sybil swarm from diluting accountability. Asymmetric capital depreciation and escrow seizure compound across linked offenders, creating an exponential multiplier in capital loss upon detection; a lagoon, harbor, or reef of aliases is therefore economically unsafe.
